title: Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation - Gravitational Acceleration
body: A satellite orbits Earth at an altitude of 400 km above Earth's surface. Calculate the gravitational acceleration at this altitude. Given: Mass of Earth = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg, Radius of Earth = 6.4 × 10⁶ m, G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg².
